The role: The founder currently does this himself. We already have a Shopify developer who builds whatever is needed e.g. coding the new offer. What’s missing is the person who d
 what gets built and why, what is the next offer test, what is the next conversion lever that we will pull. That’s you. You’ll work beside the founder every day until you’re better at it than he is; that’s the goal, and we mean it.

Own profit per visitor, revenue per visitor, AOV, gross margin and conversion rate across product pages, cart, checkout and post-purchase

Turn an idea into a mockup in Canva or Figma, write a clear brief for the developer, or make the simple changes yourself

Run split tests all the time, never zero live, with a hypothesis, a metric and a stopping rule set before launch

Read results properly, call the winner, kill the loser, write up what we learned every week in plain English



Who this is for

2+ years hands-on with Shopify DTC stores, working on AOV, upsells and conversion, not just traffic

You’ve run real A/B tests and can talk through one in detail, including one that lost and what it taught you

Clear written English; your briefs and test reports are how the work moves



MOST IMPORTANTLY: Curious and hungry & extremely hard working. You want to be excellent at this and you’ll put in the hours

This is a real growth role, we have access to some of the best courses in the game including evolve, carl weiche etc.

What you get



Daily work to become a CRO beast

Paid access to top CRO courses and a structured learning path

A real progression route: Head of Post-Click today, Growth Manager as the brand scales

title: FOIA Researcher - Public Records Requests for Police Bodycam Footage
description:

 worth a video, request the footage and reports from the agency that holds them, and track every request until the files arrive. We may hire more than one person, and we're looking for people to work with us on an ongoing basis.



Picking the right i
 matters as much as the request. We want stops with a clear story and a big reaction, not routine paperwork, and we want each request in before the agency deletes the footage.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Find i
 worth requesting in news reports, agency press releases, arrest records and social media, and log the date, place, agency and case number.



- Write and submit requests through each agency's portal or by
, from our business

 or arrest report, and 911 calls where they help the story.

- Follow up on overdue requests, answer the agency's questions, and send us every cost estimate to approve before anything is paid.



- When a request is refused because the case is still open, note when to ask again, and ask again.



- Download the files before the links expire, save them to our shared Google Drive with the case details, and note in one line what's on them and whether it's worth a video.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Experience with US public records requests, ideally for bodycam footage used on YouTube.



- Clear, professional written English for
s to records offices.



- Organisation: hundreds of open requests, each at a different stage, and none forgotten.

- Reliability and a short daily update.



- Bonus: knowing how the public records laws differ from state to state, or experience with records portals such as GovQA, NextRequest or JustFOIA.



Workload: To start, about 20 new requests a week, plus follow-ups on every open request.



Turnaround: Requests sent within 2 days of us approving an i
, and agency
s answered within 1 business day.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "cherry" and include:



1. Your
 address

4. Your current workload: how many requests you manage a week, for how many clients, and how many more you could take on for us

- Support preparation of financial information for business tax filings.

- Maintain records of business income, deductible expenses, and contractor payments.

- Track relevant tax deadlines, filing requirements, and outstanding documentation.

- Coordinate tax-related records and requests with external US-based CPAs or tax professionals.

- Assist with organizing financial records for year-end tax reporting and compliance reviews.



8. Financial Reporting and Management Accounts

- Prepare monthly profit and loss (P&L) statements.

- Prepare cash flow reports and expense summaries.

- Provide accounts payable and receivable reports.

- Track recurring revenue and monthly recurring revenue (MRR).

- Prepare client profitability and campaign expenditure reports.

- Prepare administrative and operating cost reports.

- Provide budget-versus-actual analysis.

- Highlight financial discrepancies, unusual expenses, and budget variances.

- Support management with financial data for business planning and decision-making.



9. Financial Controls and Documentation

- Maintain accurate, complete, and auditable financial records.

- Establish consistent expense categorization and reconciliation procedures.

- Maintain organized invoices, receipts, contracts, and payment documentation.

- Support internal financial controls and documentation requirements.

- Protect confidential company and client financial information.



Required Qualifications and Experience



- Minimum 2 years of professional accounting or bookkeeping experience.

- Experience working with US-based businesses or clients.

- Practical experience with Xero or QuickBooks Online.

- Hands-on experience with Stripe and payment reconciliation.

- Practical experience supporting US tax reporting and IRS compliance.

- Familiarity with US federal and state business accounting requirements.

- Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, AP, and AR.

- Experience tracking CAPEX, OPEX, administrative costs, and operating budgets.

- Experience managing advertising expenditure, campaign costs, or client-level financial reporting.

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and meet reporting deadlines.

- Availability for the specified US Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Qualifications



- CPA qualification.

- ACCA qualification or part-qualified status.

- Experience with digital marketing, advertising, or creative agencies.

- Experience with both Xero and QuickBooks Online.

- Familiarity with US GAAP.

- Experience with US federal and state tax filings.

- Familiarity with IRS Forms 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, and W-9 documentation.

- Experience coordinating with US-based CPAs or tax preparers.

- Experience with sales tax reporting across multiple US states.

- Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads expenditure reporting.

- Experience with client profitability, campaign budgets, and ROAS reporting.

- Experience with multi-currency accounting and international contractors.



Technology Stack



| Platform | Purpose |

| Xero / QuickBooks Online | Accounting and bookkeeping |

| Stripe | Payment processing and reconciliation |

| Google Sheets / Excel | Financial tracking and reporting |

| GoHighLevel | CRM and client information |

| Google Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |

| Meta Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |

| TikTok Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |



Working Schedule and Compensation

- Monday–Friday.

- 2:00 PM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time.

- 2 hours per day.

- 10 hours per week.

- US$4–6 per hour.

- Fully remote freelance/contractor arrangement.



Applicants must confirm their availability for the fixed schedule and state their expected hourly rate within the advertised range.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

1. Updated CV.

2. Answers to all 15 screening questions.

3. CPA, ACCA, or other professional qualification details.

4. Portfolio or anonymised accounting work samples.

5. Confirmation of availability for the specified working hours.

6. Expected hourly rate and earliest start date.



Portfolio and Work Sample Requirements



Applicants should provide relevant examples of previous accounting work, such as:

- Anonymized Xero or QuickBooks reports.

- Profit and loss statements.

- Cash flow reports.

- Bank and Stripe reconciliations.

- CAPEX and OPEX tracking.

- Advertising campaign expenditure reports.

- Client-level profitability reports.

- Administrative cost reports.

- AP and AR reports.

- Tax reporting support documentation.



Applicants must not disclose confidential, proprietary, or personally identifiable information belonging to previous employers or clients. Independently recreated or anonymized examples are acceptable.



Application Screening Questionnaire — 15 Questions



1. How many years of professional accounting or bookkeeping experience do you have, and what qualifications do you hold (CPA, ACCA, or other)?



2. Describe your experience managing accounting for US-based businesses or clients, including the number and types of businesses you supported.



3. Have you worked with digital marketing, advertising, or creative agencies? Describe your accounting responsibilities.



4. What experience do you have tracking CAPEX, OPEX, administrative costs, software subscriptions, contractor expenses, and operating budgets?



5. Have you tracked and reconciled advertising campaign expenditure across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, or other platforms? Explain your experience.



6. Have you managed client-level budgets, revenue, campaign costs, retainers, project expenses, and profitability? Describe your reporting process.



7. How many years of practical experience do you have with Xero and QuickBooks Online? Which platform are you most proficient in?



8. How many years of hands-on Stripe experience do you have, including transaction and payout reconciliation?



9. Have you handled Stripe fees, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, and reconciliation with accounting software? Explain how you investigate payout discrepancies.



10. Describe your experience with bank reconciliation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, contractor payments, monthly P&L statements, cash flow reports, and budget-versus-actual reporting.



11. Describe your experience with US federal and state tax reporting, IRS requirements, W-9 documentation, 1099 reporting, sales tax, and coordination with US tax professionals. Have you supported business tax filings?



12. What experience do you have managing subscriptions, monthly recurring revenue, client retainers, and multi-currency accounting?

14. Provide links to anonymised accounting work samples or a professional portfolio, including financial reports, reconciliations, campaign expenditure reports, client profitability reports, or tax reporting support documentation.



15. Can you work Monday–Friday, 2:00 PM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time, for 10 hours per week? State your expected hourly rate within US$4–6 and your earliest start date.



Important Scope Clarification

This position focuses on bookkeeping, financial operations, management reporting, and tax-compliance support. Independent tax advice, signing tax returns, or providing licensed tax and audit services are outside the role unless the candidate holds the necessary professional qualifications and authorization.

description:
JOB TITLE: Executive Assistant to the Founder | Communications & Operations



TYPE: Full-time, remote, independent contractor



SCHEDULE: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Manitoba, Canada time, with agreed breaks. This corresponds to 9:00 PM–6:00 AM Philippine time.



ABOUT KIRAS



Kiras Engineering Ltd. is a Canadian engineering consulting firm with a remote team. We are seeking an exceptionally organized, proactive Executive Assistant to work directly with our Founding Principal.



Your purpose is to manage communications, commitments and scheduling so the founder can focus on engineering decisions, quality reviews, clients and business growth.



This role requires strong judgement, confident communication and the ability to take ownership without waiting for step-by-step instructions.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage the founder’s inbox: independently resolve administrative matters, coordinate with our team, prepare drafts for approval and identify questions requiring technical input.

• Answer incoming calls, handle administrative enquiries, screen prospective clients and connect callers with the appropriate person.

• Manage professional and personal calendars, time-block priorities, prepare meetings and protect focused working time.

• Capture tasks from
s, calls, Teams and messaging apps; delegate within authority and follow through to completion.

• Handle routine internal and external communication on the founder’s behalf.

• Prepare concise decision briefs explaining the issue, deadline, options and recommended next step.

• Maintain project records and Monograph, obtain updates from project managers and flag deadline risks.

• Support proposals, estimates, invoicing, payment follow-ups, reporting and staff-review administration.

• Develop practical administrative workflows and improve them over time.

• Assist with marketing and outreach when core responsibilities are under control.



This is an executive assistant position with high-level project coordination responsibilities. Project managers retain responsibility for project delivery, and engineers retain responsibility for technical decisions.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Excellent spoken and written English, including confident client-facing telephone and video communication.

• Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and follow through without repeated reminders.

• Strong attention to detail, discretion and professional judgement.

• Confidence to ask thoughtful questions, propose solutions and flag problems early.

• Experience supporting a founder, executive or busy professional is strongly preferred.

• Competence with Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, calendars, spreadsheets and task-management tools.

• Ability to learn technical terminology and use approved AI tools responsibly.

• Reliable internet, suitable call equipment and a private working environment.



Engineering, construction or professional-services experience is an asset.



EXPECTATIONS AND SUCCESS



You will receive onboarding, feedback and technical guidance. By the end of the first month, we expect increasing independence and reliable ownership of the agreed core workflows.



Success means routine matters are resolved, commitments are tracked, deadlines are visible, and the founder receives prepared decisions rather than a stream of unfiltered messages.



Strict confidentiality is essential. You must give Kiras your full focus during the required hours; other commitments must not interfere with availability or performance.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send your résumé and answer these three questions:



Describe a situation where you identified a problem and resolved it without waiting for instructions. What did you do, and what was the outcome?



How would you manage an urgent client call, a team request and a new meeting request while the founder is in a protected work session?



Confirm your availability for the stated schedule, your current work commitments and your earliest possible start date.

TRUTH OVER COMFORT

title: Systems Analyst, Accounting & AI
description:
About the position 

Full time, Los Angeles business hours. Up to ₱225 per hour, paid for hours worked. Opportunities for quick advancement. If the hours or pay don't work for you, please don't apply.



Only Applications sent through this link will be considered: 





About us



We are a property management company in Los Angeles. We run the business on our own software: leasing, maintenance, inspections, move-ins and move-outs, tenant and owner portals, staff hours, payroll and accounting. We build it with Claude, an AI that writes the code.



The role:

You run the day-to-day development of that software. You d
 what needs building or fixing, instruct Claude, test the result, and make sure staff can use it.

You don't need to code. You do need to know accounting and how business systems are set up, well enough to spot when a number is wrong and find out why.

One hour it's a wrong label on a screen. The next it's an owner statement that won't balance. You report to the head of technology.



What you'll do:

Write clear instructions for Claude to build features and fix problems.

Test every change in our test environment before it goes live.

Take bug reports from staff, find the cause, get it fixed, and confirm with them.

Answer staff questions about the system using the actual records.

Keep the system documentation current.

Know how money moves: rent, owner payouts, management fees, vendor bills, security deposits, payroll, bank accounts.

When the bank, Buildium and owner ledgers disagree, find the reason and get it corrected.

Make sure no payment leaves the system without a person approving it.

You troubleshoot to the root cause, not the symptom.



Nice to have:

Daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot at work.

US property management accounting: owner statements, security deposits, trust reconciliations.

Business systems analyst or ERP consultant background.

Payroll experience (Gusto or similar).



What the first 90 days will look like:

Days 1-30: learn the software and how to work with Claude, starting with small fixes.

By day 90: own bug reports and staff questions end to end, shipping fixes across the system.



Requirements: 

Degree in accounting, finance or accounting information systems.

Solid accounting knowledge: reconciliations, AP and AR. Trust accounting a plus.

Experience setting up or running a business system: accounting software, ERP, CRM, or property management software (Buildium, AppFolio, Yardi).

Company Christmas gift

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
Growth Marketing Specialist



About eXpand AD

eXpand AD is a growth marketing agency serving B2B businesses across the United States and Canada. We help businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, and strengthen their digital presence.





Position Overview

The Growth Marketing Specialist manages content marketing, GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM operations, lead generation, and sales execution for eXpand AD and its clients. The role also includes social media management, reporting, and basic website support.



Key Responsibilities



1. Content Marketing and Social Media

Produce at least 5 complete content packages per week for eXpand AD and its clients.

Develop content concepts and calendars aligned with client briefs, brand guidelines, target audiences, and marketing objectives.

Create copy, graphics, carousels, short-form videos, captions, and calls to action.

Adapt approved content for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

Use Canva and AI tools to support content production.

Schedule and publish approved content; monitor reach, engagement, clicks, inquiries, and leads where measurable.

Support WordPress publishing and basic SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO).

Maintain organized content files and publication schedules.

Content package definition: One campaign-ready deliverable containing the relevant concept, copy, creative assets or video, captions, and calls to action as appropriate. Repurposing the same package across platforms does not count as an additional package. Five packages is the weekly minimum, not a maximum.



2. GoHighLevel CRM and Automation

Maintain accurate contacts, lead sources, pipeline stages, tasks, and follow-up dates.

Manage opportunities from initial lead entry through closed-won or closed-lost status.

Configure and maintain approved workflows, calendars,
 sequences, and basic automations.

Investigate failed actions, duplicate messages, and missed follow-ups.

Ensure active opportunities have a documented status and next step.

Update CRM records within one business day of relevant activity.

Improve pipeline visibility, automation reliability, and follow-up processes.

Support approved client CRM tasks within the assigned scope.



3. Sales and Customer Acquisition

Research businesses and decision-makers in the United States and Canada.

Build targeted prospect lists and conduct personalized outbound outreach through approved channels.

Qualify prospects based on business fit, need, authority, timing, and budget where ascertainable.

Manage follow-ups, book discovery meetings, handle objections, prepare approved proposals, and close deals within delegated authority.

Track sales activity, proposals, opportunity outcomes, customer acquisition, and revenue through GoHighLevel.

Analyze lost opportunities and recommend improvements to outreach and conversion.



Monthly sales target: 10 new paying customers.

A completed deal means a new customer purchasing an approved eXpand AD service, recorded in GoHighLevel and verified under the company's sales process. Leads, meetings, and proposals alone do not count. Performance will be assessed in context of lead availability and quality, offer competitiveness, sales-cycle length, resources, and timely commercial approvals.



4. Reporting and Coordination

Submit one consolidated weekly report covering content output, measurable performance, CRM activity, qualified leads, meetings, pipeline progression, closed deals, revenue where available, blockers, and next steps.

Maintain accurate records and communicate issues promptly.

Follow approved client communication and campaign procedures.

Obtain approval before committing to pricing, proposals, discounts, campaigns, or other external commercial commitments.

Flag capacity constraints and deadline risks promptly.



Work Prioritization

The role is limited to 20 hours per week. Unless otherwise directed, priorities are:

Scheduled content deliverables and urgent client commitments.

Active sales opportunities, follow-ups, and meetings.

CRM accuracy, pipeline maintenance, and automation reliability.

Website support and other improvements.

The specialist must communicate competing deadlines and capacity constraints promptly.



First 14 Days

The initial 14 days focus on onboarding, understanding company services and target customers, learning brand standards, verifying system access, and establishing an actionable sales pipeline.



Expected activities:

Complete onboarding and review services, target audiences, and sales materials.

Review existing marketing assets, calendars, brand guidelines, and client requirements.

Verify access to GoHighLevel, WordPress, Canva, AI tools, and other required systems.

Establish a content production and publishing schedule.

Begin producing at least 5 complete content packages per week.

Review the sales pipeline, identify follow-up opportunities, and begin prospecting.

Verify CRM data quality and identify workflow issues.

Submit weekly progress reports.

The manager will review progress at day 14 and agree on subsequent priorities. Initial performance will account for onboarding, access, lead availability, approval turnaround, and sales-cycle length. The ongoing target of 10 new paying customers per month remains the commercial objective.



Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of marketing, growth, or related experience.

At least 2 years of direct sales experience, including prospecting, qualification, follow-up, and closing.

Practical GoHighLevel CRM and sales-pipeline experience.

Professional English suitable for client calls with US and Canadian businesses.

Working knowledge of Canva, WordPress, and AI productivity or content tools.

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, or equivalent applications.

Ability to create content for multiple platforms and follow brand guidelines.

Strong communication, organization, and independent execution skills.

Evidence of personal contribution to previously closed sales deals.

Ability to meet the agreed schedule independently.



Languages

English: Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Additional languages: French, Spanish, Arabic, and German are advantageous. Applicants should specify their proficiency levels.



Working Terms

Location: Remote; international applicants welcome.

Contract: Part-time freelance.

Rate: US$4/hour, up to 20 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM US Eastern Time. Applicants must verify local working hours.

Additional hours: Require prior approval.

Tools and expenses: Required company accounts and resources will be specified. No subscriptions or expenses may be incurred on behalf of the company without prior written approval.

Future opportunity: Full-time work may be considered based on performance, business needs, and budget; it is not guaranteed.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

Resume or professional profile.

Short introduction describing relevant experience.

Examples of personally closed deals, including role, approximate value, and contribution.

Evidence of practical GoHighLevel experience.

Relevant marketing portfolio or work samples.

Earliest available start date.

Confirmation of acceptance of the hourly rate and schedule.

Languages spoken and proficiency levels.

Redact confidential client information. Do not submit passwords or private customer data.



Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a structured interview covering content production, GoHighLevel, sales experience, English communication, office-suite proficiency, additional languages where relevant, availability, and evidence of previous work and personally closed deals.



Performance Management



Performance will be reviewed through regular check-ins and a weekly scorecard covering:

Content packages completed and approved.

Delivery timeliness and quality.

title: Business Operations Manager for a US College Events Company (Full-Time, Remote, Leadership Role)
description:
Hello, and thank you for reading carefully. Most applicants will not. That is the first test.



We are Nightly, a college events and media company based in Dallas, Texas. We produce concerts and festivals for college students across the United States, run a ticketing platform, and are growing fast. Our team is small, senior, and kind, and our culture runs on a few simple rules: own your lane completely, report clearly every day, celebrate each other's wins in public, and treat every night we produce as if it matters, because to the students in that room, it does.



Here is our honest problem, because the right person will find it exciting. Our people are talented and they work hard. What we do not have yet is a senior operations specialist whose craft is making sure everything that was agreed actually happens, gets confirmed, and gets proven. Artists are owed replies, venues are owed documents, partners are owed follow-ups, contracts sit out for signature. Today that tracking lives in our Chief Operating Officer's head, on top of her real job. We are hiring the person who turns it into a system.



Your mission: nothing Nightly agrees to dies quietly. Every commitment has an owner, a date, and proof when it closes.



What you will own:

- The master operating system for open work: every agreement and its age in days, every deliverable owed to us and by us, every counterparty confirmation requested and whether it arrived

- The follow-up cadence: warm, persistent, well-written chasing that keeps relationships strong while deadlines move. You will draft and send follow-ups, log every response, and surface aging items before they become emergencies

- The verification standard: a task closes when there is proof (the post is live, the
 was sent, the document is signed), never on someone's say-so. You will build the trackers and checks that make this effortless for the team

- The operations rhythm: daily exception lists for the COO, inputs for the Friday money and agreements summary, and meeting action items captured with a name and a date the same day

- Process design: when something slips twice, you do not just fix it, you redesign the step so it cannot slip the same way again



Who you will work for, stated plainly: you report to our Chief Operating Officer. She sets direction and priorities for the whole company, and she is the first to say that this role exists because your craft, operations systems and follow-through, should be deeper than hers. That is how we build: leadership directs and inspires, and we hire specialists who are genuinely the best at what they do. If you are the kind of operator who has quietly been the most organized person in every company you have worked for, you will be valued here, publicly and specifically. Our best people are thanked by name in front of the whole team, and operators who close loops get more scope fast.



What you bring:

- Senior operations, chief of staff support, or program coordination experience, ideally with a US or international company, with systems you built that outlived you

- Excellent written English. You will write to venues, artist teams, sponsors, and partners in our name, and your writing must be warm, clear, and impossible to misunderstand

- A systems brain: you see a messy week and instinctively reach for a tracker, a cadence, and an escalation rule. Advanced Google Sheets or Excel skill is required; CRM experience is a strong plus

- Calm, kind persistence. You can ask a fourth time and make the person glad you did

- Judgment about what counts as done, and the confidence to tell a senior person, respectfully, that their item is not closed yet

- Reliability across US Central Time hours, with at least 4 hours of daily overlap, and flexibility during event weeks



What we offer:

- Full-time, long-term leadership role. We are building our core team, not filling a gig

- $1,150 to $1,350 per month depending on experience, paid weekly for the first month, then on a regular schedule. 13th month pay included. We pay at the top of the market for this role on purpose, because we want the best operator we can find

- A direct line to the COO and founder, real authority over the systems you build, and a growth path toward senior operations leadership as the company scales

- A team that notices. The people who create order here are celebrated by name, in public, often



How to apply: answer the screening questions below in your own words. Short and specific beats long and polished. We reply to every serious application. Shortlisted candidates receive a paid test task (described in the questions) before any offer, because we hire on proof, the same standard the job itself runs on.



Screening questions:

1. Describe the best tracking or follow-up system you have ever built. What was falling through the cracks before it, what did you build, and what changed measurably?

2. A venue was promised a signed document last Tuesday. It has not gone out. The person who owes it is senior to you and underwater. Write the exact follow-up message you would send today: warm, clear, and effective.

3. A teammate tells you their task is done, but there is no link, document, or confirmation you can check. What do you do, step by step, and how do you keep the relationship warm while you do it?

4. Tell us about a process you redesigned after something failed twice. What was the failure, and what did you change so it could not happen the same way again?

5. What hours (Philippine time) can you reliably work, how much overlap with US Central Time (9am to 5pm CT) can you cover, and are you available for occasional evening event-week coverage?

6. In two or three sentences: why does follow-through matter more than talent in an operations role?

title: Production Manager
description:
About Us



Creation Station Printing is a one-source print and promotional products company. For over a decade, we have helped businesses get their printing, promotional products, branded online storefronts, inventory management and fulfillment handled in one place. With our home base in Austin, Texas, and our warehouse in Leander, we serve business customers nationwide.



The Role



We are looking for a Production Manager who knows the vendor side of print inside and out. Many of the jobs we deliver involve our network of trusted print partners and suppliers, and this role makes sure each of those jobs is placed with the right partner, at the right price, and arrives on time.

You will own vendor sourcing, purchasing and the production calendar, from the moment an order comes in until it lands at our warehouse or the customer’s door. You will also support our customers with quotes and timeline updates.

What You’ll Do



Vendor Sourcing & Purchasing

Match each job to the right print partner or supplier based on product, decoration method, quantity, budget and deadline.

Request custom quotes from vendors for jobs that can’t be priced online, and negotiate pricing and turnaround times.

Place vendor orders and purchase orders, pay vendor carts, and keep company payment details current on vendor portals.

Own and maintain our vendor list and vendor portal logins.

Grow and strengthen our vendor network: find new partners, compare pricing, and track each partner’s quality and on-time record.



Production Scheduling & Order Tracking

Own the production calendar: schedule partner-produced jobs and move them as priorities change.

Track every vendor order from placement to delivery, following up on proofs, production status and shipping.

Make sure orders arrive on time, whether at our warehouse or directly at the customer.

Spot problems early (delays, shortages, misprints) and resolve them with the vendor before they reach the customer.

Pass approved artwork from our art team to the vendor, and relay vendor feedback (for example, a file that is too low-resolution for the ordered size) back to the art team. No design work required.

Coordinate with the warehouse team so incoming vendor shipments are expected and received, and arrange freight for larger shipments when needed.



Customer Support

Prepare and send customer quotes, including recommending the right product when a request is loosely defined.

Keep customers updated on order timelines and set clear, realistic expectations.



What You Bring

2+ years of experience in purchasing, vendor management or production coordination, ideally in printing, promotional products or apparel decoration.

Working knowledge of print and decoration methods (such as screen printing, embroidery, digital and offset printing, and large format) and which partner fits which job.

A proven ability to juggle many orders and deadlines at once without letting anything slip.

Clear, professional written communication with vendors and customers.

Comfort working in web-based ordering systems, vendor portals,
 and shared calendars.

A detail-oriented approach: you double-check quantities, specs, ship dates and costs before an order goes out.



Nice to Have

Experience with promotional products industry resources such as ASI or SAGE.

Experience with WooCommerce/WordPress order management, HubSpot or Google Workspace.

Experience arranging LTL/freight shipments.



Schedule & Details

Schedule: FULL TIME Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Central

Location: Remote with screen shared and recorded

Reports to: Ownership

Pay: $6-$12+

Benefits: Paid U.S. holidays (with the option to swap them for your local holidays), a 13th-month bonus, and two weeks of paid vacation after 6 months with the company.

Training: Hands-on training via theoretical and practical examples.

title: Title: Sales Operations Coordinator (GoHighLevel) | Full-Time | UK Hours
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



We're a fast-moving, ambitious UK-based property education and mentoring business supporting property investors. We're good to work with, and people who love it here stay for years.



Our sales team runs appointment setting, discovery calls and webinars. This role sits at the center of keeping that engine clean, accurate and well reported.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a key role in the business, and it's for someone who leans into doing a great job and likes being busy. It's fast-paced, so you'll need to get up to speed quickly and be comfortable handling a full workload from early on.



This is a sales operations role, not a general admin or EA role. You'll work directly with the sales team: the appointment setters and the call closers.



Your main job is to keep the CRM clean. Every lead that reaches a setter should be complete, accurate and ready to call. You'll know what good data looks like, spot what's missing or wrong, and fix it before it slows anyone down.



You won't be building automations. They're already set up, so you'll use what's in place and focus on keeping the pipeline healthy.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Own the GoHighLevel pipelines: keep opportunities in the right stages, lead statuses correct, and duplicates and missing data cleaned up

• Make sure every lead passed to the setters is clean, complete and ready to call

• Run regular pipeline check-ins and clean-ups so nothing stalls unnoticed

• Build and send weekly sales performance reports covering calls, connects, bookings, attendance and conversion

• Track and verify commission numbers each cycle and prepare them for sign-off

• Spot gaps in setter and closer activity from the data and raise them early

• Keep trackers and documentation current so the team works from one version of the truth

• Support webinars and events on the operational side, plus light recruitment and onboarding admin for new sales hires



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Hands-on GoHighLevel experience (required), especially managing pipelines and opportunities day to day

• Strong CRM data management: you know what clean, complete lead data looks like and how to keep it that way

• Confident in Google Sheets and Excel: you can build and maintain trackers and reports, not just update ones someone else made

• Comfortable handling figures that affect what people get paid, with a clear process for checking your own accuracy

• Someone who leans into doing a great job, enjoys being busy and wants a key role in a growing business

• Proactive and one step ahead: you ask questions, raise issues early and don't wait to be told what's broken

• Able to get up to speed quickly in a fast-moving environment

• Experience working inside or alongside a sales team, ideally with appointment setters or sales reps

• Strong written English and the confidence to raise an issue with a senior stakeholder

• Organized, independent, and able to run your own week without close supervision

• Reliable home setup: own computer, stable internet, backup power and internet, and a quiet dedicated workspace



NICE TO HAVE



• Experience in property, real estate, coaching or education

• Exposure to commission or incentive tracking

• Experience supporting webinars or live events



SCHEDULE AND TERMS



• Full-time, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM UK time (7:00 PM to 4:00 AM Manila time)

• Rate: £4 per hour during the 3-month probation, £5 per hour after

• Paid monthly

• Time tracked via Time Doctor

• Long-term role, remote, independent contractor basis

• This needs to be your only job during these hours



HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through this form:

title: Influencer & Partnership Development Specialist

(Paid Trial + Performance Incentives)

TYPE OF WORK



Gig / Part-Time



WAGE / SALARY



PHP 3,000 (Paid Trial) + PHP 8,000/month + Performance Incentives



HOURS PER WEEK



Approximately 15 hours



JOB OVERVIEW



We are looking for someone who enjoys research, relationship building, and thoughtful outreach.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant or administrative role.



Your mission is to identify the right influencers, business partners, and industry professionals, then start meaningful conversations that can lead to long-term partnerships.



This position requires strategic thinking, research, and personalized communication—not mass messaging.



If you rely on copy-and-paste templates or spam outreach, this role is not for you.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Research influencers, creators, brokers, and professionals

Understand each person's audience and positioning

Write personalized outreach messages (Instagram, LinkedIn, Email, etc.)

Send one thoughtful follow-up when appropriate

Track conversations using Google Sheets

Continuously improve outreach based on reply quality and results

HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



We do NOT measure hours worked.



Instead, we evaluate:



Reply rate

Quality of replies

Meaningful conversations started

Qualified meetings

Professional communication

Continuous improvement

PAID TRIAL



The trial period lasts approximately 1–2 weeks.



Trial Compensation

Fixed payment: PHP 3,000

Performance incentives also apply during the trial



The trial includes:



Research

Personalized outreach

Follow-ups

Progress tracking

Reporting



Successful candidates will be invited to continue working with us long-term.



LONG-TERM COMPENSATION



After successfully completing the paid trial:



Fixed monthly payment: PHP 8,000

Additional performance incentives every month

PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES



In addition to the fixed payment:



JPY 500 for each qualified reply that demonstrates genuine interest in discussing a collaboration.

JPY 3,000 for each completed online meeting.



A qualified reply must show clear interest in learning more about a potential collaboration.



Meeting incentives are paid only when the scheduled online meeting is actually completed.



Outstanding performers may receive additional bonuses and increased responsibilities over time.



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

You use copy-and-paste messages.

You send mass outreach without research.

You cannot explain your outreach strategy.

You dislike researching people before contacting them.

REQUIRED APPLICATION TASK



To apply, complete the following exercise.



Choose ONE of the following:



A US-based real estate influencer

A broker serving international clients



Then submit:



1. Cold DM



Write a personalized outreach message.



2. Follow-up



Write ONE follow-up message.



3. Strategy



Explain:



Why you chose this person

Why your message should receive a reply

What response you hope to achieve

4. Target Link



Provide their Instagram, LinkedIn, or website.



Applications may not be considered if:



Messages are generic

No personalization is shown

No strategy is explained

The selected target is not relevant

LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



Successful applicants will have the opportunity to continue working with us long-term.



Compensation and responsibilities will grow based on:



Performance

Reply quality

Meeting quality

Overall contribution



If you enjoy research, strategic communication, and building valuable business relationships, we'd love to hear from you.
